title: BlueBlocks: Kubernetes Production Manifests
description:
Create Kubernetes manifests for production-grade deployment.

## Requirements

### Core Components
- StatefulSets for validators (persistent identity)
- Deployments for stateless nodes
- PersistentVolumeClaims for blockchain data
- ConfigMaps and Secrets management

### Networking
- Services (ClusterIP, LoadBalancer)
- Ingress with TLS termination
- NetworkPolicies for isolation
- Service mesh consideration (Istio/Linkerd)

### Scaling
- Horizontal Pod Autoscaler for nodes
- Vertical Pod Autoscaler for resource optimization
- Pod Disruption Budgets for updates

### Monitoring
- ServiceMonitor for Prometheus
- Grafana dashboard ConfigMaps
- Alerting rules

### Files to Create
kubernetes/
├── base/
│   ├── namespace.yaml
│   ├── configmap.yaml
│   ├── secrets.yaml
│   ├── node-deployment.yaml
│   ├── validator-statefulset.yaml
│   ├── miner-deployment.yaml
│   ├── service.yaml
│   └── networkpolicy.yaml
├── overlays/
│   ├── devnet/
│   ├── testnet/
│   └── mainnet/
└── kustomization.yaml
